screens.screen: debts list (الديون): search, segmented tabs, debt cards with balance / totals / repayment bar, 'دين جديد' FAB
home (الرئيسية): six section tiles, sync card, recent entries, floating glass nav pill
debt details (تفاصيل الدين): party header, currency summary, receipt/payment actions, statement of transactions with running balance

notes: Drawn from the current v2 code (the 'Hajar' design system: hajar_tokens/text/tone/glass), light theme, as an admin sees it (the 'قيد يدوي' tile is admin-only). Fonts are the app's own ReadexPro files; icons are the real Solar glyphs taken from the owner's local solar_community_icons package (1.3.0, code points unchanged from the 1.2.0 the app pins). All names, phone, addresses and amounts are invented sample data - nothing was read from the production book. Figures are consistent across screens: the first debt card and the detail screen are the same party (YER 750,000 debit - 300,000 credit = 450,000 owed, 40% repaid, running balances 300,000 -> 550,000 -> 450,000) and the newest receipt (JV-2026-000418, YER 100,000) is also the first row of 'آخر القيود' on home. The glass nav pill's backdrop blur/rim is approximated with CSS shadows. The optional cards that appear only in special states (update available, held drafts, clock warning, pending users, legacy-system buttons) are omitted as in a normal synced session.
